title: スプリンターズSの後に・次の満腹！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The people who came expecting a comedy show are left in awe by the sheer power the two racers put on display.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is thrilled that she was able to go full tilt during the race, and we've also confirmed that her body's in top form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We agree to have her run in the Mile Championship, but before that, we decide to take on the Swan Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, as we celebrate and Taiki Shuttle is beside herself with excitement in the stands, Biko Pegasus mourns her loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race ends with a mix of emotional highs and lows… and our attention now shifts to the Swan S.
